query: Create a new knowledge skill for enforcing that every outbound customer email uses a verified customer name and never includes an unsupported claim. Which eval checks should be deterministic, and which need model judgment?
expected_behavior: Uses deterministic checks for machine-verifiable requirements such as required fields or banned literal phrases when the output format makes them exact
Keeps semantic support for claims and correct name use tied to supplied customer evidence in the behavior rubric
Creates at least six distinct cases spanning normal, missing-evidence, ambiguous, and adversarial requests
Does not claim static fixture checks prove the skill beats a no-skill baseline
